verdict.rationale: The only residency-related evidence is a workaround for teams with data residency or PII requirements: use synthetic email addresses with an email relay so real addresses aren't stored outside a given jurisdiction. Nothing in the pack shows you can choose a storage region for workspace data. Missing for 10: documented region/data-center selection (e.g., US vs EU workspaces), residency coverage beyond email addresses, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
